description: Parses config/parameters.toml with tomllib, validates it via validate_parameters, and constructs the three typed parameter dataclasses consumed by acquisition, enrichment and analysis.
signature: def load_parameters(path: Path) -> tuple[AcquisitionConfig, EnrichmentParams, AnalysisParams]
docstring:
Load and validate the machine-readable mirror of FORMULATION.md.

Args:
    path: Absolute path to config/parameters.toml (typically Settings.parameters_path).

Returns:
    A (AcquisitionConfig, EnrichmentParams, AnalysisParams) tuple, fully validated.

Raises:
    ParameterError: On a missing file, missing section/key, an out-of-range value, a weight set that does not sum to 1, or an unordered multiplier triple -- delegated to validate_parameters for everything past the missing-file check.
postconditions: On success, the three returned dataclasses satisfy every invariant listed in their own specs
The function performs no writes; parameters.toml is read-only from config's perspective (ADR-012 / config non_goals)

edge_cases.expected_behavior: ParameterError naming the expected path (not a raw FileNotFoundError leaking to the caller)

edge_cases.input: path exists but is not valid TOML syntax
edge_cases.expected_behavior: ParameterError wrapping the tomllib.TOMLDecodeError with the file path and line/column if available

edge_cases.input: path exists, is valid TOML, but fails validate_parameters
edge_cases.expected_behavior: propagates the ParameterError raised by validate_parameters unchanged

unit_tests.name: test_load_parameters_accepts_complete_fixture
unit_tests.description: tests/fixtures/parameters_valid.toml loads into three populated, mutually consistent dataclasses.

unit_tests.name: test_load_parameters_missing_file
unit_tests.description: A nonexistent path raises ParameterError naming that path.

unit_tests.name: test_load_parameters_each_invalid_fixture
unit_tests.description: Each of tests/fixtures/parameters_invalid_*.toml (missing section, missing key, out-of-range ratio, weights not summing to 1, unordered multiplier triple) raises ParameterError.
unit_tests.expected: ParameterError for every fixture in the glob
